cases.question: Tell me about Pdfroo
cases.judge_reason: All claims match the expected facts and known public details about Pdfroo.
cases.answer:
**Pdfroo** is Ayush's fully client-side PDF editor — open a PDF, annotate, sign, rearrange/merge pages, and download a real flattened PDF. Nothing ever leaves the browser; all parsing, rendering, and writing happen locally via **pdf.js + pdf-lib**, and it works offline once loaded.

**Highlights**
- **Zero backend** — no build step, no install, runs from `file://` or any static server
- **Responsive** — phone (375 px), tablet (768 px), desktop (1440 px+) with mouse, pen, or touch
- **Pages panel** — thumbnail sidebar (desktop), slide-in drawer (tablet), bottom sheet (phone); drag-to-reorder via SortableJS, rotate, duplicate, delete, insert blank, merge multiple PDFs
- **Find & replace**, **compress**, **sign** — all in-browser
- **Privacy-first** — after first successful download, a kangaroo toast confirms: *"Your PDF never left your device"*
- **Landing page** — custom kangaroo mascot (SVG), local fonts (Fredoka/Nunito/Baloo 2), Indian-language section, light/dark theme

**Tech:** JavaScript, CSS, HTML | **Deploy:** GitHub Actions → GitHub Pages  
**Repo:** [ayush4u/pdfroo](https://github.com/ayush4u/pdfroo) | **Live:** [ayush4u.github.io/pdfroo](https://ayush4u.github.io/pdfroo/)
